description: What ~/.ssh/config becomes when the app adds its one include line (CLOUD-12, issue #611). null means the file is left as it is. Rust's files.rs and the TypeScript stand-ins (platform/memory.ts) both answer these cases.

cases.name: an empty file gets the line and a blank line
an existing file keeps every byte after the line
Windows line ends and a missing final newline are kept
the line already there is not added again
a commented-out line counts as there, as Conductor's check counts it
an include of another file is not this app's line
